verses.text: Ay jun winh winak yelxo te chuk spensar t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri. Ix spu nok' sch'aak winh, ix k'e somnaj heb' anima chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha onh tik malaj kalan kik t'a winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí tik. Konh paxek t'a ko pat ko masanil a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' israel chi' ix aktankan winhaj rey David chi', haxo yet' winhaj Seba chi' ix b'at heb'. Axo heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá, ix kannhej heb' yet' winh rey chi', ix kot heb' yet' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán masanto t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix jax winhaj rey David chi' t'a spalakio t'a Jerusalén, ix yik'anelta lajunhwanh heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh, haton heb' ix aykan stanhwej spat winh chi', ch'ok junxo pat b'aj ix tanhwaj heb' ix. Toxonhej ix ak'ji tas swa heb' ix, palta majxo waylaj winh yet' heb' ix. Ata' ix kannhej heb' ix masanto ix cham heb' ix, icha heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix ajkan heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Amasa: --B'at molb'ejkot masanil heb' winh winak yik Judá, haxo chab'ej tzach jawi yet' heb' winh t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Amasa chi' smolb'ej heb' winh, palta ix ek' tiempo, maj jalaj winh icha wal sk'ual yaj yalankan heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Abisai: --Tekan to ek'b'al ol onh yixtej winhaj Seba tik t'a yichanh icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Absalón. Yuj chi' kuchb'ej masanil heb' soldado, tzach b'at t'a spatik winh, haxo talaj tz'aji tz'och winh skol sb'a t'a junok chonhab' ayoch smuroal, tz'el winh t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' soldado yik winhaj Joab yet' heb' kereteo, heb' peleteo yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado te jelan, ix el heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil jun niwan tenam ay t'a Gabaón, ata' ix schalaj sb'a winhaj Amasa chi' yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Joab ayoch spichul winh yik owal, ayoch jun kincho t'a snanhal winh. Ha t'a snanhal winh chi' jachanoch jun k'een espada ayem t'a yol yatut. Ayik wan sk'och winh yak' stzatzil sk'ol winhaj Amasa chi', ix k'eta jasnaj k'een yespada winh chi', ix sik'anxik'e k'een winh.
Ix syaman xil sti' winhaj Amasa chi' winh yet' swach' k'ab' yik stz'ub'anelta sti' winh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Wach' am ix ach ajelk'och wuk'tak? xchi winhaj Joab chi'.

Ha winhaj Amasa chi' max snalaj winh yuj k'een espada ix siq'uixk'e winhaj Joab chi'. Axo ix aji, ix stipanoch k'een winh t'a sk'ol winhaj Amasa chi'. Ix elta lanhnaj yol sk'ol winh smasanil t'a sat lu'um. Junnhej ix yak' winhaj Joab chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' winh yuk'tak chi', haton winhaj Abisai t'a spatik winhaj Seba chi'.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' soldado winhaj Joab chi' ix och linhan t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha mach ayoch yet' winhaj Joab yet' pax winhaj rey David, ochokab' tzak'an yuj winhaj Joab chi', xchi winh.

Ix kan telan sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi' t'a skal schiq'uil t'a yol b'e chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun winh soldado chi' to ayik wan yek'ta heb' soldado t'a stz'ey sniwanil winhaj Amasa chi', tz'och linhan heb' yila', yuj chi' ix snherkanel winh t'a ti' b'e, ix slich'anb'at jun k'apak winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayik toxo ix snherkanel winh chi', ix ek'b'at heb' soldado smasanil, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Joab say winhaj Seba chi'.

Ha winhaj Seba chi', ix ek' winh smolb'ej heb' soldado t'a junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Abel-bet-maaka. Axo masanil heb' yinhtilal Bicri tzak'anxo och heb' yuj winh, ix och heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' soldado winhaj Joab t'a Abel-bet-maaka chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik, ix sb'oanoch lum lum heb' stek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak smuroal chonhab' chi', yik syak'an owal heb' t'ay. Ix och ijan heb' smak'anem weknaj smuroal chi'.

Ata' ay jun ix ix te ay spensar, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ab'ek, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Alek t'a winhaj Joab chi' to skot winh t'a tik, yujto tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' winh, xchi ix.

Ayik ix k'och winh t'a slak'anil ix, ix sk'anb'an ix icha tik: --¿Tom a ach tik ach Joab? xchi ix t'a winh. --Ha in toni, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Ab' tas ol wal a in a chekab' in tik, xchi ix. --Tik swab'i, xchi winh.
Ix syamanoch ix yalan icha tik: --Ha t'a peka' tz'alji icha tik: Ha mach snib'ej syojtakejel junok tasi, sk'anb'ejokab' t'a chonhab' Abel, xchi. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj junok tasi.

Ha onh kajan onh t'a jun ko chonhab' tik, ichnhej ta' kajeq'ui, k'anab'ajum onh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Dios. Te niwan pax yelk'och jun ko chonhab' tik. Palta a achxo tik tza nib'ej tza sateli. ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza satel tastak to yik Jehová yaji? xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Manh ichokta' wan in naani yik tzin sataneli.

Manhok jun chi' sko saya', palta a jun winh skuchan Seba yuninal winhaj Bicri aj tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín sko saya'. Ha jun winh chi' ix k'e waan winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj rey David. Anhej winh tzeyak' t'a yol ko k'ab', tzonh el t'a jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh. --T'a yib'anh muro tik ol ko julem sjolom winh t'ayach, xchi ix.

Yuj sjelanil spensar ix chi', ix b'at ix smontej heb' yetchonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzepanel sjolom winhaj Seba chi' heb', ix sjulanemta heb' t'a winhaj Joab chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh to spukhaj nok' ch'aak yik tz'el heb' t'a jun chonhab' chi', yuj chi' ix paxkan junjun heb' soldado t'a spat, ix meltzajpaxkan winhaj Joab chi' t'a Jerusalén yik b'at lolon winh yet' winh rey chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj skanxi winhaj Joab chi' yajalil t'a skal masanil heb' soldado yik Israel, haxo pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, a winh yajal yaj t'a heb' kereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo.
Ha winhaj Adoram tz'ilan heb' aynhejkanoch sb'oan munlajel, haxo winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Sewa stz'ib'an yab'ixal winh rey chi' t'a stzolal. Axo winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar, sakerdote yaj heb' winh.
Axo pax winhaj Ira, aj chonhab' Jair, sakerdote yaj winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.
